settings_agents_agent_add_agent: Button in Settings > Agents, custom agents group: saves the agent typed in the form above it.
settings_agents_agent_approval_ask: Option of the Tool approval switch in Settings > Agents: the agent waits for the person's OK. Must match the word used in settings_agents_agent_approval_description.
settings_agents_agent_approval_auto: Option of the Tool approval switch in Settings > Agents: the agent never asks. Must match the word used in settings_agents_agent_approval_description.
settings_agents_agent_approval_descripti: Help line of the Tool approval row in Settings > Agents. Explains the two options of the switch by their names, so it must name them as settings_agents_agent_approval_ask and settings_agents_agent_approval_auto do.
settings_agents_agent_args_description: Help line of the extra-arguments row of one installed agent in Settings > Agents. {label} is the agent's name (Claude Code, Codex...). The flag in the example is literal.
settings_agents_agent_args_label: Label and accessible name of the extra-arguments field of one installed agent in Settings > Agents. {label} is the agent's name.
settings_agents_agent_arguments: Label of the field that holds the arguments of a custom agent in Settings > Agents. i18n-distinct: the CLI help heading of the same word is another screen and translates on its own.
settings_agents_agent_coding_agents: Title of the first group of Settings > Agents: the installed coding agents, the default agent and tool approval.
settings_agents_agent_command: Label of the field that holds the executable of a custom agent in Settings > Agents.
settings_agents_agent_custom_agents: Title of the group of Settings > Agents where a person adds an agent CLI Atlas does not know. Same wording as the Settings search entry.
settings_agents_agent_custom_description: Help line of the custom agents group in Settings > Agents. {key} is the shortcut that starts an agent, filled by kbd(). The command `atlas hook` and the file docs/agents.md stay as written.
settings_agents_agent_default_agent: Label of the row that picks which agent a new agent tab starts, in Settings > Agents.
settings_agents_agent_default_blank: Last option of the default agent list in Settings > Agents: no agent, a plain terminal.
settings_agents_agent_default_descriptio: Help line of the default agent row in Settings > Agents. Names the last option of the list, settings_agents_agent_default_blank.
settings_agents_agent_environment: Label of the multi-line field with environment variables of a custom agent in Settings > Agents.
settings_agents_agent_environment_placeh: Placeholder of the environment field of a custom agent in Settings > Agents: one KEY=value pair per line. The shape of each line is named like this in the form errors (settings_general_agent_form_env_pair).
settings_agents_agent_installed: Help line of an installed agent in Settings > Agents when Atlas knows neither its version nor its path. i18n-distinct: the INSTALLED column of `atlas skills` is a CLI table heading.
settings_agents_agent_name: Label of the field that holds the name of a custom agent in Settings > Agents. i18n-distinct: the NAME column of `atlas skills` is a CLI table heading.
settings_agents_agent_not_installed: Help line of an agent that is not installed, in Settings > Agents. The noun for the computer comes from the OS (your Mac, this PC, this computer).
settings_agents_agent_quick_add_button: Button of the quick commands group in Settings > Agents that adds an empty quick command.
settings_agents_agent_quick_add_hint: Help line of the add-a-quick-command row in Settings > Agents, shown only while there is no quick command. Two example button names.
settings_agents_agent_quick_add_label: Label of the row that adds a quick command in Settings > Agents.
settings_agents_agent_quick_command: Label of the field of a quick command that runs a shell command (kind Run in terminal).
settings_agents_agent_quick_commands: Title of the group of Settings > Agents with the one-click buttons of the tab strip.
settings_agents_agent_quick_description: Help line of the quick commands group in Settings > Agents.
settings_agents_agent_quick_kind: Label of the list that picks what a quick command does (run in the terminal or send to the agent). i18n-distinct: the crewmate role card asks the same words about a role, a different field.
settings_agents_agent_quick_kind_termina: Option of the quick command kind list: run the command in a terminal. The other option is capture_quick_page_send_to_agent.
settings_agents_agent_quick_name: Label of the field that holds the text on the button of a quick command.
settings_agents_agent_quick_prompt: Label of the field of a quick command that sends text to the agent (kind Send to agent).
settings_agents_agent_quick_remove: Accessible name of the trash button that deletes one quick command in Settings > Agents.
settings_agents_agent_quick_scope: Label of the list that picks where a quick command shows (every project or one).
settings_agents_agent_quick_scope_all: First option of the quick command scope list: the button shows in every project.
settings_agents_agent_remove_label: Accessible name of the trash button of one custom agent in Settings > Agents. {label} is the agent's name.
settings_agents_agent_resume_arguments: Label of the field that holds the extra arguments of a custom agent when it resumes a session; its placeholder uses {session}.
settings_agents_agent_tool_approval: Label of the row and accessible name of the switch that picks whether agents ask before running tools, in Settings > Agents.
settings_agents_crew_add_server: Title of the group of Settings > Atlas Crew where a person adds a crew server.
settings_agents_crew_added: Toast after a crew server was added in Settings > Atlas Crew. {name} is the display name typed, or the host of the SSH target.
settings_agents_crew_adding: Label of the add button of the crew server form while the server is being added.
settings_agents_crew_agent_signed_in: Chip of Settings > Atlas Crew showing an agent (engine) the crew server can use. {label} is the engine name. The agent is signed in.
settings_agents_crew_agent_signed_out: Chip of Settings > Atlas Crew showing an agent (engine) the crew server can use. {label} is the engine name. The agent is not signed in yet.
settings_agents_crew_agents: Label of the row of Settings > Atlas Crew that lists the agents (engines) installed on one crew server.
settings_agents_crew_description: Description under the title of Settings > Atlas Crew. The command in backticks is literal.
settings_agents_crew_display_name: Accessible name of the display name field of the add crew server form.
settings_agents_crew_display_name_option: Placeholder of the display name field of the add crew server form.
settings_agents_crew_enabled: Label of the checkbox that turns short replies on for one crew server.
settings_agents_crew_model_placeholder: Placeholder of the field that holds the summary model of short replies in Settings > Atlas Crew. The model id in the example is literal.
settings_agents_crew_onboarding: Title of the last group of Settings > Atlas Crew, the one that replays the introduction. Same word as settings_registry_crew_group_onboarding.
settings_agents_crew_open_workspace: Button of the GitHub row in Settings > Atlas Crew: closes Settings and shows the crew workspace, where the GitHub accounts are connected.
settings_agents_crew_pause_hint_paused: Help line of the pause row of a crew server in Settings > Atlas Crew while that server is paused.
settings_agents_crew_pause_hint_running: Help line of the pause row of a crew server in Settings > Atlas Crew while that server runs.
settings_agents_crew_pause_label: Label of the pause row of a crew server in Settings > Atlas Crew while it runs. While paused the row says crew_workspace_sidebar_footer_paused.
settings_agents_crew_phones_empty: Shown in the paired phones row of a crew server in Settings > Atlas Crew when no phone is paired with that server.
settings_agents_crew_remove_confirm: Text of the confirmation before a crew server is removed from Settings > Atlas Crew. {name} is the server's display name.
settings_agents_crew_remove_hint: Help line of the remove row of a crew server in Settings > Atlas Crew. Nothing is deleted on the server.
settings_agents_crew_remove_server: Label of the row that removes one crew server from Atlas in Settings > Atlas Crew.
settings_agents_crew_removed: Toast after a crew server was removed in Settings > Atlas Crew. {name} is the server's display name.
settings_agents_crew_replay: Button that replays the Atlas Crew introduction, in Settings > Atlas Crew.
settings_agents_crew_replay_description: Help line of the replay onboarding row in Settings > Atlas Crew. Same sentence as settings_registry_crew_crew_onboarding_description.
settings_agents_crew_replay_onboarding: Label of the row that replays the Atlas Crew introduction, in Settings > Atlas Crew. Same wording as settings_registry_crew_crew_onboarding_label.
settings_agents_crew_status: Label of the row that shows whether a crew server is reachable, in Settings > Atlas Crew.
settings_agents_crew_status_offline: Status text of a crew server that Atlas cannot reach, in Settings > Atlas Crew. i18n-distinct: crew_workspace_status_offline is the state of a crewmate, not of a server.
settings_agents_crew_status_online: Status text of a crew server that Atlas reaches, in Settings > Atlas Crew. i18n-distinct: crew_onboarding_ready_hero_online is a tooltip of an illustration.
settings_agents_crew_summary_model: Accessible name of the field that holds the summary model of short replies for one crew server.
settings_agents_crew_target: Label and accessible name of the SSH target field (user@host) of the add crew server form.
settings_agents_crew_target_description: Help line of the SSH target field of the add crew server form. The command in backticks is literal.
settings_agents_crew_title: Title of the Settings > Atlas Crew page. Atlas Crew is the product feature and never translates.
settings_agents_mobile_description: Description of the Pair a phone group in Settings > Mobile. The noun for the computer comes from the OS (your Mac, this PC, this computer). Said in the pair card's words (celulares pareados).
settings_agents_mobile_empty_body: Body of the empty state of the paired phones group in Settings > Mobile. It names the button of the pair card by reference ({@mobile_pair_card_show_code}) so the two never drift; the noun for the computer comes from the OS.
settings_agents_mobile_empty_loading: Title of the empty state of the paired phones group in Settings > Mobile while the list is loading.
settings_agents_mobile_empty_title: Title of the empty state of the paired phones group in Settings > Mobile once the list loaded and no phone is paired.
settings_agents_mobile_title: Title of the first group of Settings > Mobile, the one with the pairing code card.
settings_agents_paired_phones: Title of the paired phones group in Settings > Mobile and label of the paired phones row of a crew server in Settings > Atlas Crew. Same words as the pair card of the mobile area.
settings_agents_ssh_add_host: Button of Settings > SSH hosts that adds the host picked from the SSH config.
settings_agents_ssh_add_host_description: Help line of the add a host row in Settings > SSH hosts.
settings_agents_ssh_add_host_label: Label of the row of Settings > SSH hosts that adds a host from ~/.ssh/config.
settings_agents_ssh_add_project: Button of the remote project group in Settings > SSH hosts that registers the project folder.
settings_agents_ssh_add_project_descript: Help line of the row with the add project button, in the remote project group of Settings > SSH hosts.
settings_agents_ssh_add_project_label: Label of the last row of the remote project group in Settings > SSH hosts (the row that holds the add project button).
settings_agents_ssh_host: Label of the row that picks the SSH host of a remote project in Settings > SSH hosts.
settings_agents_ssh_host_description: Help line of the host row of the remote project group in Settings > SSH hosts.
settings_agents_ssh_no_hosts: Label of the empty row of the hosts group in Settings > SSH hosts when no host is added.
settings_agents_ssh_no_hosts_description: Help line of the empty row of the hosts group in Settings > SSH hosts. The file in question is ~/.ssh/config.
settings_agents_ssh_pick_placeholder: Placeholder of the list of hosts from the SSH config in Settings > SSH hosts.
settings_agents_ssh_project_added: Toast after a project on an SSH host was added in Settings > SSH hosts.
settings_agents_ssh_project_folder: Label and accessible name of the field that holds the folder of a remote project in Settings > SSH hosts. i18n-distinct: onboarding_flow_project_folder names a local folder picked in onboarding.
settings_agents_ssh_project_folder_descr: Help line of the project folder field in Settings > SSH hosts.
settings_agents_ssh_remote_project: Title of the group of Settings > SSH hosts that adds a project living on a host.
settings_agents_ssh_remote_project_descr: Help line of the remote project group in Settings > SSH hosts. atlas.yaml is the project file and stays as written.
settings_agents_ssh_status_connected: Chip text of an SSH host with a live connection, in Settings > SSH hosts. Mapped from the status id `connected` that the desktop shell reports. i18n-distinct: crew_workspace_integrations_catalog_connected is the state of an integration.
settings_agents_ssh_status_connecting: Chip text of an SSH host while Atlas connects, in Settings > SSH hosts. Mapped from the status id `connecting`. i18n-distinct: crew_onboarding_install_done_label is a step of the install checklist.
settings_agents_ssh_status_error: Chip text of an SSH host whose connection failed, in Settings > SSH hosts. Mapped from a status that starts with `error`; the raw reason shows below the row.
settings_agents_ssh_status_idle: Chip text of an SSH host the desktop shell has not reported on yet, in Settings > SSH hosts. i18n-distinct: crew_workspace_status_idle is the state of a crewmate.
settings_agents_ssh_status_outdated: Chip text of an SSH host connected through an Atlas older than the desktop needs, in Settings > SSH hosts. Mapped from a status that starts with `warning`; the raw detail shows below the row.
settings_agents_ssh_status_removed: Chip text of an SSH host that was just removed, in Settings > SSH hosts. Mapped from the status id `removed`. i18n-distinct: cmd_setup_done_removed is a CLI result word.
settings_agents_ssh_test_atlas_missing: Result line of Test connection in Settings > SSH hosts when atlas is not installed on the host. {system} and {arch} are the host's uname values (Linux, x86_64).
settings_agents_ssh_test_result: Result line of Test connection in Settings > SSH hosts. {system} and {arch} are the host's uname values and {atlas} is the first line printed by `atlas version` there.
settings_agents_ssh_your_hosts: Title of the first group of Settings > SSH hosts: the hosts already added.
